method: Separate source-color and grayscale ink masks are curve-fitted with Potrace 1.16. Tiny islands retain native contours in revision 2. Every final asset passes raw-source ink/local-edge/transparency checks and all source/vector pairs were visually compared. Failed automatic or visual candidates retain the preceding native contours byte-for-byte. No generated content or embedded raster.

visual_review.checked: All source/vector pairs inspected for dots, thin/dashed lines, hard corners, arrowheads, numerical labels, N/S lettering, gray/color object shades and label contrast polarity. Six automatic passes were visually rejected for color-layer contrast/boundary degradation and restored to the checked original native contour assets.
